messages:
mike_infra: Quick ask — new customer tenant redd-ml-prod is ready to onboard but Azure quotas are blocking us. We need ND40rs_v2 x4 and NC24rs_v3 x8 in westeurope, and ND40rs_v2 x2 in francecentral. Can someone open quota + capacity reservation requests?

anita_cloudops: On it. I'll open support SRs and request a capacity reservation (reservation + quota) for the onboarding window. What dates do we need to reserve?

mike_infra: Onboarding window: 2027-04-05 to 2027-04-12 (can be flexible ±2 days). Prefer guaranteed allocation for first 48 hours. Also need a short note to MS: low-latency inference workloads, KV-cache heavy.

jason_enginfra: Filing SRs now. Creating one per region/sku to keep tracking separate. Will tag cost-center=redwood-ops and add subscription id sub-0a1b2c3d4e.

az-bot: Azure Support request created: SR#202704010001 (westeurope ND40rs_v2 quota). Link: https://portal.azure.com/#blade/Microsoft_Azure_Support/HelpAndSupportBlade/~/request/202704010001

luis_oncall: SR#202704010002 (westeurope NC24rs_v3 capacity reservation) created and escalated to "Capacity Management". :eyes:

mike_infra: Thanks. Can we also include a soft-fallback plan in case capacity can't be reserved? i.e., fall back to NDv2 family or use burst from dedicated pool. Need guidance for app team.

anita_cloudops: Good call. Adding fallback to SRs: 1) allow fallback to NDv2-compatible instances ND24rs (if perf acceptable), 2) temporary routing to dedicated pool in northeurope (we have spare). Asking MS to approve cross-region burst in emergency.

jason_enginfra: Command I ran to check current SKU availability:
```
az vm list-skus --location westeurope --size ND40rs_v2 --output table
az vm list-usage --location westeurope --output table
```
Put these in the SR notes.

steph_sales: FYI — customer expects go-live on 2027-04-07. If MS can't commit capacity, we may need to push go-live or offer a staged rollout (embeddings only first). What is the cost delta for reserved capacity?

mike_infra: Preliminary numbers: reservation for ND40rs_v2 (4x) about ~$18k/month; NC24rs_v3 burst reserve (8x) ~ $7k/month. I'll get finance to confirm. Staged rollout is acceptable if reservation takes longer.

emily_sre: Added monitoring hooks to the onboarding cluster. If we get partial capacity, autoscale to prevent OOMs. Also added trace-level logs for KV cache misses to evaluate perf impact if we fallback to ND24rs.

anita_cloudops: MS replied in SR#202704010001: "Work with Capacity Mgmt team; usual lead time 7-10 days for ND40rs_v2 in westeurope. Temporary approval possible if you provide workload profile and commit to reserved capacity." Pushed for same-day escalation.

luis_oncall: For tracking, creating internal ticket INFRA-5279 and linking SRs: 202704010001, 202704010002, 202704010003 (francecentral ND40rs_v2). Will update ETA in the ticket.

mike_infra: Please annotate INFRA-5279 with required billing code and tags. Also update rollout doc with fallback mapping and user-visible degradation risk.

jason_enginfra: Added billing code tag cost-center:redwood-ops to INFRA-5279 and set priority=P1 for the week. Also scheduled a sync with MS capacity team tomorrow 09:30 CET. Invite sent to @mike_infra @anita_cloudops @steph_sales.

anita_cloudops: Final note — if we get reservation, need to request quota increase in the same SR (MS sometimes closes reservation request without increasing quota). Explicitly asked for both reservation and quota in SR notes.

mike_infra: Perfect. Thanks everyone. Will update customer and prep staged rollout plan. :thumbsup:
